description: one row per reference: scopes, rules, label groups, then (labels only) the pairing profiles giving the label and the workload count

rule.description: rule: its position in the ruleset as the TUI's Policy screen lists it, from 1

excluded.description: the rule side or scope names it as an exclusion

pending.description: a draft change not provisioned yet, the PCE's update_type (create, update, delete) of the rule, else its ruleset (scope: the ruleset; label_group: the group); null when provisioned as it is

disabled.description: the rule or its ruleset is disabled; pairing_profile: the profile is disabled

via.description: the label group it is reached through, when not named directly

name.description: label_group: the group's name; pairing_profile: the profile's name

count.description: workloads: how many workloads carry the label

exact.description: workloads: false when count is a lower bound (at least)

locked.description: pairing_profile: whether the profile locks the label's key (role, app, env, loc); null for other kinds, for keys with no lock and when the profile does not say

href.description: the rule's, the ruleset's (scope), the group's, the pairing profile's, or the label's (workloads)
